dict.string: TrailMark records short video memos for your field journal.
TrailMark reads your steps, distance, energy, heart rate and sleep to show your daily activity and recovery.
TrailMark saves your recorded activities to the Health app as workouts.
TrailMark records the route of your journey and geotags the memos you capture.
TrailMark records voice memos for your field journal.
TrailMark reads motion data to detect your cadence and activity.
Used to pick a video on the Simulator, which has no camera. (Optional - device-only flow doesn't need it.)
